executiveSummary: Third-candidate dossier: economist/commentator and LPAR chair with anti-duopoly election reform message. Strengths: communicator credential, calm panel demeanor, mandate-skeptic appeal to burden-weary clerks. Weaknesses for Kelly contrast: no SOS administration experience, reform themes without county implementation detail. Kelly strategy: respect on stage, administrator differentiation, never attack L voters.

whatTheyClaim.claim: Will bring economist/data skills for fiscal transparency in SOS office
Arkansas elections lack competitiveness — reforms needed for diversity of ideas
Independent SOS administrator outside two-party duopoly
Will enhance SOS public profile through communication and analysis
